title: A Happy Breakfast
setting: A small house in the morning: a bathroom and a bright kitchen.

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: The morning sun comes up in the east.
sentences.zh: 早晨的太阳从东方升起。
sentences.scene_prompt: The morning sun rises over the roofs, seen through a kitchen window.

sentences.en: Kofi changes his wet socks in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 科菲在卫生间换下湿袜子。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt sits in a small bathroom and pulls on dry socks, wet socks on the floor.

sentences.en: Hana makes tea, her favorite morning drink.
sentences.zh: 哈娜泡茶，那是她早上最喜欢的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress pours hot tea from a teapot into a cup in the kitchen.

sentences.en: Kofi gets bread and a sharp knife.
sentences.zh: 科菲拿来面包和一把锋利的刀。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt takes a loaf of bread and a knife from the kitchen counter.

sentences.en: He cuts the bread into eighteen thin pieces.
sentences.zh: 他把面包切成十八片薄片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt cuts a loaf of bread into many thin slices on a wooden board.

sentences.en: Breakfast is ready, and it is time to eat.
sentences.zh: 早餐准备好了，该吃饭了。
sentences.scene_prompt: A kitchen table with bread, tea and plates, ready for breakfast.

sentences.en: Kofi sits down between Hana and the window.
sentences.zh: 科菲在哈娜和窗户之间坐下。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt sits down at the table between Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and a sunny window.

sentences.en: Hana says thanks, and they both laugh.
sentences.zh: 哈娜说了声谢谢，两人都笑了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana, a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow dress and Kofi, a young boy with short black hair and a blue shirt laugh together at the breakfast table.
